notes.title: Stay! Stay! DPRK Adult Patch is out Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Adult Patch Release[/h1]
You guys knew this day would come... the [b]Stay! Stay! DPRK: Glorious Waifu Edition adult patch[/b] is finally out!

[url=www.devgru-p.com]Click here to visit our website where you can download it now![/url]

[h1]DLC Music Release[/h1]
Also, don't think we forgot all you guys asking for a way to get the soundtrack! We've put that up on Steam for you guys to pick up, if you like the music and feel like chipping a couple of bucks our way to help us fund our next game, [b]Mein Waifu is the Fuhrer[/b].

You can pick up the [b]soundtrack here on Steam[/b] by clicking on the picture below!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/659710/Stay_Stay_DPRK_Original_Soundtrack/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/659710/header.jpg?t=1498165375[/img][/url]
